MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II). A 21-item self-report questionnaire measuring depressive symptom severity over the preceding two weeks. Each item is scored 0-3, yielding a total score range of 0-63.

bdi_total.Description: BDI-II total score. Sum of all 21 items. Range: 0-63. Higher scores indicate greater depressive symptom severity.

bdi_cog.Description: BDI-II cognitive-affective subscale score, based on the female-specific factor structure described by Dozois et al. (1998).

bdi_som.Description: BDI-II somatic subscale score, based on the female-specific factor structure described by Dozois et al. (1998).
